name: monkeytype-frontend
description: Static frontend build of monkeytype, packaged for Nix. Backend removed: this tree serves anonymous, local-only typing tests.

scripts.build: npm run build:pkg && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:pkg: npm run build -w @monkeytype/tsup-config && npm run build -w @monkeytype/schemas && npm run build -w @monkeytype/util && npm run build -w @monkeytype/contracts && npm run build -w @monkeytype/challenges && npm run build -w @monkeytype/funbox
